text.id: Kacamata tanpa bingkai. Rambut belah samping, rapi. Senyum yang kebanyakan. Di belakangnya spanduk "BPM GOLF DAY".
text.en: Rimless glasses. Neat side-parted hair. A smile that's a bit too much. Behind him, a banner. "BPM GOLF DAY".

text.id: Didit. Nomor yang nyuruh gue berhenti nyari, tengah malem itu, adalah nomor Didit sendiri.
text.en: Didit. The number that told me to stop looking, that midnight, was Didit's own.
